bio: Antony has lived in West Hampstead with his family for over 20 years having previously lived in Australia, New York, and Switzerland. As one of the churchwardens, he helps oversee the practical and financial aspects of parish life, while also supporting the Church's mission and ministry. He has a particular interest in the rich variety of Christian traditions, interfaith engagement, and how faith can shape everyday life for the better. He's also always happy to talk about cricket.
name: Antony Edwards
